summary: Full e2e test of SignCraft sign-shop CRM (backend + frontend). Backend: 22 pytest cases across auth (login/register/me/refresh/lockout/bcrypt), RBAC, materials/customers/estimates/invoices/bills CRUD, estimate->invoice convert, dashboard math, Xero CSV exports, portal orders + reorder lifecycle -> 21 passed / 1 failed (invalid ObjectId -> 500). Frontend: admin login->dashboard KPIs, all 8 nav routes, Materials CRUD (create/edit/delete, margin %), Customers CRUD, Estimates (material autofill, 2 line items, 10% tax totals $195/$19.50/$214.50, edit, convert->INV, delete), Invoices (mark paid, delete, Xero CSV download), Payables (record bill, mark paid, edit keeps PAID, Xero bills CSV, delete, stat cards recompute), Receivables (only unpaid listed, Receive -> empty state + collected updates), customer self-registration -> /portal with role customer, RBAC redirect /dashboard->/portal + sidebar reduced to 1 link, reorder submit -> visible in portal and staff Reorders, staff advance requested->processing->completed, logout. All core flows PASS.

critical.issue: Malformed id raises bson.errors.InvalidId -> HTTP 500 (traceback in backend.err.log). Should validate id and return 400/404.

Guarded only by get_current_user, so a customer-role account can read internal cost + supplier + stock for every material (verified: cost 1.2 returned to a freshly registered customer). Restrict to staff or strip cost/supplier for customers.

minor.issue: Brute-force lockout keyed on request.client.host, which behind the k8s ingress is the proxy pod IP (multiple replicas). Observed 7 wrong passwords all returning 401 (attempts split across 2 proxy IPs); 429 only appeared after ~16 tries. Use X-Forwarded-For (first hop) and/or count per-email. Also locked_until is rewritten on every failure even below the threshold, and count never expires without a successful login.
Depends on get_current_user, so logging out with an expired/invalid access token returns 401 and the cookies are never cleared.
Document numbers come from count_documents()+1, so numbers are reused after a delete (reproduced: new estimate got EST-0002 twice). Use an atomic counters collection.
Full-replace update with Pydantic defaults: a client omitting 'status' silently resets a paid invoice to 'unpaid' and paid_at is left stale (never cleared on un-paying).

ui_bugs.issue: No loading state: on first paint all KPI cards render $0.00 and the counters render '—' before /api/dashboard resolves, which briefly shows misleading zeros.
React console error: '`value` prop on input should not be null' when a material has stock/category null (uncontrolled->controlled). Use '' fallback.
Radix a11y warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent' on every dialog open.

issues: Reorder title input has no data-testid (only reorder-notes and submit-reorder-btn do); had to target the first input in the dialog.
Delete actions on materials/customers/estimates/invoices/bills use window.confirm rather than an in-app confirm dialog (works, but inconsistent with the shadcn design system).

action_items: Validate ObjectId path params (helper -> 400/404) instead of 500 on all id-based routes
Restrict GET /api/materials cost/supplier data from customer-role users (or require_staff)
Fix login lockout key to use X-Forwarded-For / per-email counting; don't extend locked_until below threshold
Make logout cookie clearing work without a valid access token
Replace count_documents()+1 numbering with an atomic sequence to avoid duplicate EST/INV/BILL numbers
Add loading skeleton to Dashboard (and avoid rendering $0.00 pre-fetch); fix null value on material inputs
Add data-testid to the reorder title input; add DialogDescription/aria-describedby to dialogs
critical_code_review_comments: server.py (661 lines) is a single module - split into routers (auth, sales, ap_ar, portal, export) before it grows further
Every ObjectId(...) call on a path param is unguarded -> guaranteed 500 on bad input; add a shared parse_object_id dependency
All list endpoints use to_list(1000/2000) with no pagination or per-customer scoping - will not scale and staff endpoints load everything on each page mount
@app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') is deprecated in current FastAPI - migrate to lifespan

Auth playbook checks verified OK: bcrypt hash stored as $2b$..., httpOnly+Secure+SameSite=none cookies set on login, CORS allow_credentials=True with explicit origins (no wildcard), seed_admin updates the existing admin password when it changed
seed_data_creation: Created and then removed TEST_ prefixed materials, customers, estimates, invoices, bills, reorders and test_* customer users; ran /app/backend/tests/cleanup_test_data.py so demo seed data (2 customers, 3 materials, EST-0001, INV-0001, BILL-0001) is intact. INV-0001 was marked paid during AR testing and restored to unpaid.
test_credentials: admin chrisjacker@gmail.com / SignShop2026! (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md); customer accounts are created ad-hoc via register and cleaned up
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest.ini runs it with xdist; TestDashboard math can flake if other tests create invoices in parallel - re-run with -n 0 to confirm). Cleanup helper: /app/backend/tests/cleanup_test_data.py (deletes TEST_* docs and test_* users). Known open items: invalid-ObjectId 500 (test_invalid_id_handling is the failing test), material cost exposure to customer role, lockout keyed on proxy IP. Frontend flows all verified via Playwright; note the Receivables table always renders one row (the 'Nothing outstanding' empty-state row), so assert on text not row count.
rca_of_the_issue: 500s: path-param ids are passed straight into bson ObjectId(); a non-hex string raises bson.errors.InvalidId which FastAPI turns into 500 (confirmed in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log). Lockout unreliability: identifier = f'{request.client.host}:{email}' and the ingress presents different pod IPs (10.231.129.137/.138 observed), so the failure counter is split and the 5-attempt threshold is not reached in 5 tries. Material cost leak: list_materials depends on get_current_user rather than require_staff and returns the raw document including cost/supplier.
